gaps.reasoning: No finance, controller, or CFO title appears among the four named team members, and no funding history is disclosed despite the company operating a capital-intensive physical fleet (e-cargo bikes) and servicing a named enterprise client. This is consistent with the signal of a company with revenue or funding activity but no strategic finance function.

notes_for_human: Evidence base is thin - a single company website with no funding, pricing, or hiring signals disclosed, and only one named customer relationship. Confidence on all gaps is capped at medium because each rests on a single clear indicator (team roster plus one customer claim) rather than two independent sources. Operations-supply-chain and technical-leadership-cto archetypes were considered but disqualified: Stephen Reynolds is named Head of Operations and Alfie Lobb is named Head of Development, so those roles appear filled at a senior-title level even though seniority/depth cannot be verified from this evidence.
